name: @bitspark/ontos-json
description: ontos-total-json/1 and ontos-readable-json/1: the total and the readable JSON projections of ground values, read from UTF-8 bytes with their own strict reader and written deterministically. TypeScript peer of projection/json/{go,rs,py}. Depends on @bitspark/ontos-core, @bitspark/ontos-codec and @bitspark/ontos-data.
